integrity: One theorem with exact-mean-root centering, its deterministic cutoff shift and consequent threshold-specific centering regimes. A self-contained checker supplies finite arithmetic and numerical convergence diagnostics, not an infinite theorem certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed quorum fraction in (0,1), aligned harmonic weights and independent Poisson first-arrival clocks only. Gaussian inversion proven via triangular-array Lindeberg; no finite-sample error rate or de-Poissonization. Historical priority against all broader general theorems is not independently certified.
title: Gaussian fluctuations and the two-thirds centering boundary for critical Zipf quorum times
